data.one_liner: A Dart wrapper for interacting with the Android Debug Bridge (adb).
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to run adb commands, manage devices, forward ports, install apps, and read logcat output. It abstracts adb invocation and error handling for easier use in Dart/Flutter projects.
use_when: You need to automate Android device tasks from Dart code
You want to integrate adb operations into CI/CD pipelines or Flutter tooling
avoid_when: Your app runs on iOS only
You require a cross‑platform device management solution beyond Android
strengths: Supports common adb actions like install, uninstall, forward ports
weaknesses: Relies on adb being available in the system PATH
Limited to command‑line features, no high‑level abstractions
